title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 124
paragraphs: While his naval force was camped about the river Axius, the city of Therma, and the cities in between, waiting for the king's arrival, Xerxes and the land army were advancing from Acanthus, cutting through the middle by the shortest route to reach Therma. They passed through Paeonia and Crestonia to the river Cheidorus, which rises in the land of the Crestonians, flows through Mygdonia, and comes out alongside the marsh by the river Axius.
